name: Anjian 00: Shiren Xiaonanhai
source:
Have you heard of the "Cannibal Boy"? If you've heard his story, you have to hurry and tell someone who hasn't. Or else, he might just come get YOU...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1391450/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你听说过“食人男孩”吗？如果你听过他的故事，你必须赶快告诉那些没有听过的人。否则，他可能会来找你……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1391450/]Steam[/url]]
